title: How Much Do Airline Pilots Really Make?
description:

Sources:
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook: Airline and Commercial Pilots (median pay, May 2024): https://www.bls.gov/ooh/transportation-and-material-moving/airline-and-commercial-pilots.htm

scenes.narration: How much do airline pilots really make?
According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, the median airline pilot earned 226,600 dollars in May 2024.
Commercial pilots, who fly things like charters and tours, had a median of 122,670 dollars.
Median means half earn more and half earn less. Senior captains at big airlines are usually at the top.
Getting there takes years of training and flight hours. That's a big reason the pay is so high.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook: Airline and Commercial Pilots
